diagnosis.title: Is this happening in your workshop?
diagnosis.subtitle: Check these common issues. If you identify with several, the hidden cost of your operation may be higher than you think.
diagnosis.closing: If you answered 'yes' to more than one, your operation has room for improvement.

question1.question: Are you still assembling sublimation sheets manually?
question1.description: Every sheet is laid out piece by piece. Hours per order, no scaling.
question1.impact: Labour hours per order, bottlenecks before printing, delays when volume spikes.
question1.solution: The system generates sublimation sheets from the order and patterns, with optimized layout, ready to print.

question2.question: Do you waste time entering names and numbers one by one?
question2.description: Each name and number is typed or pasted onto each garment. For team or event orders, that's hundreds of entries.
question2.impact: Huge time per order, typos, rework when something goes wrong.
question2.solution: Bulk upload from a spreadsheet or list: the system assigns name, number and size to each garment and generates files with no manual input.

question3.question: Do you make mistakes with sizes, names or player details?
question3.description: Data travels via WhatsApp, Excel or paper. It gets copied wrong, a row is missed or a size is mixed up.
question3.impact: Wrong personalization, complaints, reprints and loss of customer trust.
question3.solution: Single flow with data tied to the order: the system uses the correct information per garment and cuts transcription errors.

question4.question: Do you have to redo orders because of production errors?
question4.description: Mistakes in design, size or personalization are caught after printing or cutting. Then you have to redo.
question4.impact: Wasted fabric, time and labour; delayed deliveries and unhappy customers.
question4.solution: Controlled flow from order to final file: fewer manual steps, fewer failure points, and review before printing.

question5.question: Are you wasting more fabric than you should?
question5.description: Pieces are placed by eye or with a fixed layout. Extra fabric between pieces or over-cutting.
question5.impact: Extra fabric cost, lower yield per sheet, margin eaten by waste.
question5.solution: Automatic nesting: the system arranges pieces to use fabric better and reduce leftover.

question6.question: Do you rebuild patterns from scratch for similar orders?
question6.description: Every 'new' order forces you to reassemble the pattern or layout even when it's almost the same as a previous one.
question6.impact: Hours of repetitive design work, delivery delays, little standardization.
question6.solution: Reusable pattern catalogs: pick the base, adjust what's needed and generate the order without starting from zero.

question7.question: Is order information scattered across WhatsApp, Excel and designers?
question7.description: Orders in WhatsApp, lists in Excel, files on the designer's computer. No one has the full picture.
question7.impact: Lost orders, duplicated work, mistakes from outdated information.
question7.solution: Orders in one place: same record for sales, production and delivery, with history and tracking.

question8.question: When volume goes up, does chaos go up too?
question8.description: More orders mean the same manual process repeated more. More errors, more delays, more stress.
question8.impact: Can't scale without hiring more or working late; bottlenecks around key people.
question8.solution: Automation that scales with volume: same flow for 10 or 500 garments, without multiplying manual hours at the same rate.

question9.question: Do you depend too much on one person who 'knows how everything works'?
question9.description: One or a few people hold all the knowledge. If they're absent or leave, the operation stalls.
question9.impact: Operational risk, difficulty adding staff, overload on those people.
question9.solution: Standardized processes in the system: the 'how we do it' lives in flows and templates anyone can follow.

question10.question: Is it hard to scale without hiring more people?
question10.description: More orders mean more hands on assembly, data entry and checking. Growth doesn't turn into margin.
question10.impact: Hiring just for repetitive tasks or turning down orders for lack of capacity.
question10.solution: The system does the repetitive work (sheets, data, nesting); the team focuses on design, quality and customers—you can grow without adding people at the same rate.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our platform.

question1.question: Can I upload my own patterns, fonts, and designs?
question1.answer: Yes! CimaTex allows you to upload your own clothing patterns, fonts, and graphic designs. You can combine them with our curated library of patterns and templates, giving you full flexibility to create unique, customized apparel.

question2.question: How does CimaTex help reduce fabric waste?
question2.answer: Our platform includes AI-powered 2D nesting optimization, which automatically arranges pattern pieces on the fabric to minimize unused space. This not only reduces material waste but also lowers production costs and improves efficiency.

question3.question: How does the onboarding and assistance support work?
question3.answer: Our onboarding and assistance support gives you full access to all features of your selected plan.

question4.question: Is CimaTex suitable for small clothing businesses?
question4.answer: Absolutely. CimaTex is designed to scale with your business. Small and medium-sized clothing brands can take advantage of professional design tools, production-ready file generation, and workflow management without needing a large design or technical team.

question5.question: Can I change plans later?
question5.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. If you upgrade, the new pricing will be prorated for the remainder of your billing cycle. If you downgrade, the new pricing will take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.

question6.question: What kind of support do you offer?
question6.answer: Support varies by plan. All plans include email support, with the Professional plan offering priority email support. The Enterprise plan includes 24/7 phone and email support. We also have an extensive knowledge base and community forum available to all users.
